senses.example: Communism requires conditions in which men are not restricted to a particular type of work, but can take part successively in all types and thus achieve all-round development.

While reaching last year's US Open final showed he possesses an all-round game, Anderson's biggest weapon remains his serve - which he lost in the opening game against Djokovic with a double fault on break point.

senses.definition: All around, in every surrounding place.
senses.example: Then we pass through Bebington station, and, entering a cutting, become aware of the usual signs of approach to an urban area—buildings closing in, an all-round increase in smokiness, and the application of brakes.
